description: 30 baseline tasks: document reading, coverage planning and scenario compilation. Replay success validates infrastructure; use --live for model capability.

tasks.prompt: Read the complete source document and submit exactly the documented endpoint GET /health; preserve its parameters and responses.
Design one happy_path scenario for GET /health with documented status 200; look up the endpoint first.

Read endpoint details for GET /health. Standard happy_path, optional/type/boundary/status-code coverage is already generated. Identify additional business semantics only; submit an empty plan if the trusted endpoint declares none. Standard cases already cover every declared schema constraint, including enums, multipleOf, min/max lengths, nested fields and array sizes. No additional error status or business behavior is documented.

Read endpoint details and the declared business rule for GET /items. Standard schema and status coverage is already generated; it does not check the conditional segment mapping. Plan exactly one additional business scenario for the declared conditional rule, preserve its rule_id, and do not repeat generic happy_path coverage.

business_rules.title: Conditional business result for segment2
